title: Let Truth be seen before feedback arrives
summary: The shabad steadies the heart by widening its sight — those attuned to Truth see the True One everywhere. Worth stops shrinking when the room is no longer the largest reality.
takeaway: Let Truth be seen before feedback arrives.
lifeApplication: Before checking the reply, the numbers, or the room’s reaction, name one place the True One is already present and let that sight settle you first.

source.shortMeaning: Those who meditate on Truth become attuned to Truth and begin to see the True One everywhere.
source.lifeApplication: When approval tempts you, let Truth widen your sight before the room defines you.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad gives worth a larger field of vision by revealing Truth everywhere.
evidence.turn: Let inner sight outrank the first visible reaction.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before checking the reply, the numbers, or the room’s reaction, name one place the True One is already present and let that sight settle you first.
